events.description: A 10x10 grid is initialized on screen with numbers 1 to 100 placed inside the cells, with the number 1 being invisible.
events.clip_query: A 10x10 grid of squares containing numbers from 2 to 100 appears on screen.

events.description: Multiples of 2 are highlighted with red surrounding rectangles and their text turns red.
events.clip_query: Even numbers in the grid are highlighted with red boxes.

events.description: The red rectangles fade out, composite multiples of 2 disappear, and the number 2 turns back to white.
events.clip_query: Even numbers except 2 disappear from the grid, leaving empty cells.
